description: The map n ↦ 2n is injective and its range is exactly the even natural numbers. The range misses 1, so it is a proper subset of ℕ.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FiniteAndCountableSets.even_naturals_enumeration :
  (Function.Injective fun n => 2 * n) ∧
    (Set.range fun n => 2 * n) = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.evenNaturals ∧ 1 ∉ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.evenNaturals
